articles.summary: As reported in Billboard’s Publishers Quarterly, Reservoir has earned a Top 10 U.S. market share for Q3 2026, coming in at #8 on the Top Radio Airplay evaluation with 0.87% market share. articles.title: RESERVOIR EARNS TOP 10 MARKET SHARE FOR Q3 2026
